spans.s:
(ऌ) पतॢ r. 1st cl. (पतति) r. 10th cl. (पतयति or पातयति)
1 To go, to move, but especially downwards; as, to fall, to descend, to alight.
2 To possess supreme or superhuman power.
r. 4th cl. (पत्यते)
To be rich or powerful.
With अति prefixed,
To excel or surpass.
With अभि or अव,
To descend.
With आङ्,
To arrive, to come.
With उत्,
To ascend.
With नि,
To gain or get.
2 To happen.
With निर्,
To abscond.
With परि,
1 To go fast.
3 To be valuable.
With प्र and नि,
To fall prostrate, to salute, to worship.
With वि and निर्,
To turn, to turn back.
With सम्,
1 To go with.
2 To gain.
With सम् and आङ्,
To purify or cleanse.
With सम् and उत्,
To fly.
With सम् and नि,
To go forth or out.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Cherished, protected.
m. (-तः)
1

Going.
2

Falling, alighting.
E.
पत to go, अच् aff. or a various reading of पात.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Preserved, protected.
E.
पा to preserve, aff. क्त.
m. (-तः)
1 Falling, alighting, descending.
2 A name of

Rāhu.
3

The node of a planet's orbit.
E.
पत to fall, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Who or what falls, descends, &c.
m. (-कः)
An astronomical table.
E.
पत to fall, to go, वुन aff.

f. (-का)
1 A flag or banner.
2 A flagstaff.
3 An emblem carried as an ensign or banner, a symbol, a sign.
4 A mark.
5 An episode, or episodical incident in a drama.
6 Good fortune, auspiciousness.
E.
पत to go, आकन् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-कं)
1 Sin, crime.
2 The cause of falling, literally or figuratively.
E.
पत to fall or descend, causal form, (from virtue,) aff. ण्वुल्.

m. (-गः)
A bird.
E.
पत to go, Uṇādi aff. अगच्.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A grasshopper.
2 A bird.
3 A sort of rice.
4 The sun.
n. (-ङ्गं)
1

Quicksilver.
2

A kind of Sandal.
E.
पत falling, गम to proceed, aff. खच्; or पत to fall, अङ्गच् Uṇādi aff.; also पतङ्गम.

n. (-ङ्गं)
Red sanders: see पचङ्ग, of which it appears to be a local corruption.

m. (-मः)
1 A bird.
2 A grasshopper.
E.
पत, and गम what goes: see the last.

f. (-का)
A sort of bee.
E.
कन् implying resemblance, with the fem. form added to पतङ्ग.

f. (-का)
A bow-string.

m. (-लिः)
1 The name of a saint or Muni and teacher of the Yoga philosophy, thence called after him PĀTAÑJALA; also the author of the Mahābhāṣya or commentary on PĀṆ

INI.
2

A name of the poet VARARUCI.
E.
पत falling, अञ्जलि the hands joined as a mark of respect; having fallen from heaven, it is said, in the shape of a small snake, into the hands of the saint PĀṆINI as he was performing this act of reverence.

mfn. (-तन्-तन्ती-तत्)
Falling, coming down, alighting, &c.
m. (-तन्)
A bird.
E.
पत to go, to alight, participial aff. शतृ.

n. (-त्रं)
A wing.
E.
पत to go, अचन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-त्रिः)
A bird.
E.
पत to go, अत्रिन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-त्री)
A bird.
E.
पतत्र a wing, इनि poss. aff.

m. (-जः)
VIṢṆU'S bird, Garuḍa.
E.
पतत्रिन्, and राज king.

m. (-हः)
1 A spitting pot.
2 The reserve of an army.
E.
पतत् what falls, and ग्रह what takes.

m. (-रुः)
A hawk, a falcon.
E.
पतत्^1 a bird, and भीरु fearful.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161123. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/321. note: Stray accent in print, coded as a4.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Who or what goes, falls, descends, &c.
n. (-नं)
1

Falling.
2

Alighting, descending.
3 Falling from dignity, virtue, &c.
4

Sin.
5

Going.
6

Substraction.
7

The latitude of a planet.
E.
पत to fall, युच् or ल्यट् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 A town, a city.
2 A sort of drum.
E.
पत to go, तनन् aff.

n. (-नं)
Bringing down, causing to fall.
2 Lowering, humbling.
3 Felling, knocking down.
4 Nodding, as in sleep.
E.
पत to fall in the causal form, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-मः)
1 The moon.
2 A bird.
3 A grasshopper.
E.
पत to go, अमच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु)
Falling, liable or accustomed to fall.
E.
पत to go, &c. in the causal form, आलुच aff.

m. (-सः)
1 A bird.
2 The moon.
3 A caterpillar.
E.
पत to go, Uṇādi aff. असच्.

m. (-की)
1 An ensign, a standard bearer.
2 A scheme for casting a nativity.
f. (-नी)
An army.
E.
पताका a flag, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-की-किनी-कि)
Wicked, sinful, a sinner.
E.
पातक, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Who or what goes, &c. much or frequently. पत to go, अच् aff. repeated, and आच् augment.

m. (-तिः)
1 A master, an owner.
2 A husband.
3 A root.
4 Going, motion.
E.
पा to nourish, Uṇādi aff. डति, or पत to go, with the same aff.

m. (-त्तिः)
1 A foot soldier.
2 A hero.
f. (-त्तिः)
1 Going, moving, walking.
2 A company, a platoon, consisting of one chariot, one elephant, three horse, and five foot.
E.
पद to go, ति Uṇādi aff. or क्तिन् aff. for the feminine.

m. (-तिः)
A master, a lord, a husband.
E.
पा to nourish, Uṇādi aff. अति.

f. (-घ्नी)
1 The murderess of her husband.
2 A line on the hand, indicating that a woman will be faithless or treacherous to her husband.
E.
पति a husband, and घ्न who kills, fem. aff. ङीप्.

n. (-णं)
Sign of a murderess of a husband.
E.
पतिघ्नी, and अक्षण a mark.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Fallen, alighted.
2 Fallen from virtue, wicked, abandoned.
3 Fallen in war, defeated, overthrown.
4 Degraded, outcaste.
5 Gone.
E.
पत to go, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Felled, struck down.
2 Lowered, depressed, humbled.
E.
पत to fall, causal v., क्त aff.

m. (-कः)
A man of the first three classes, whose investiture has not been duly performed.
E.
पतित, and सावित्री the mystical verse, कन् added.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Looked at by an outcaste.
E.
पतित, and ईक्षित seen.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Born of an outcaste.
E.
पतित, and उत्पन्न born.

n. (-त्वं)
The conjugal state.
E.
पति, and त्व aff.

ind.
Having fallen or fallen down, having alighted, &c.
E.
पत to fall, क्त्वा aff.

f. (-णा)
A faithful wife.
E.
पति, and प्राण life.

f. (-रा)
1 A bride choosing her husband.
2 A pungent seed, (Nigella Indica.)
E.
पति a husband, वृ to choose, खच् aff.

f. (-त्नी)
A married woman, a wife whose husband is living.
E.
पति a husband, मतुप् aff., fem. form irr., नुक् being inserted.

f. (-ता)
A good and virtuous wife.
E.
पति a husband, व्रत a religious obligation; who never violates her marriage vow.

f. (-वा)
Devotion to a husband.
E.
पति, and सेवा service.

f. (-न्ती)
A woman wishing or fit for a husband.
E.
पति, and क्यच् added, aff. शतृ.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Going, moving, one who goes or moves.
m. (-रः)
1 A bird.
2 An Arhaka, a measure so called.
3 A hole.
E.
पत to go, एरक् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि)
Pedestrian, going on foot.
m. (-षी)
A footman, a foot soldier, &c.
E.
पत् for पाद foot, कष to injure, णिनि aff.

m. (-णिक्)
A tradesman.
E.
पत्तन a city, वणिज् a trader.

f. (-ङ्क्तिः)
A line of infantry.
E.
पत्ति, and पङ्क्ति a line.

f. (-तिः)
A body of troops.
E.
पत्ति, and संहति assemblage.

m. (-रः)
A plant, commonly Śaliñca.
n. (-रं)
Red sanders.

n. (-त्त्रं)
Any vehicle or means of conveyance.
E.
पत to go, ष्ट्रन् aff.; also पत्र.

n. (-त्रं)
1 A leaf.
2 A vehicle in general; as a car, a horse, a camel, &c.
3 The wing of a bird.
4 The feather of an arrow.
5 The leaf of the Laurus cassia.
6 The leaf of a book.
7 Goldleaf, &c. any thin sheet or plate of metal.
nf. (-त्रं-त्री)
A letter, any written document or address.
E.
पत to go, ष्ट्रन् aff. and one त rejected; also sometimes पत्त्र.

n. (-त्त्रं)
A preservative from sin, a preserver, a saviour.
E.
पात् and त्र who or what saves.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं)
A vessel in general, a plate, a cup, a jar, &c.
n. (-चं)
1 A sacrificial vase or vessel, comprising various forms of cups, plates, spoons, ladles, &c. so used.
2 The channel of a river, or its course between the near and opposite bank.
3 A king's counsellor or minister.
4 Propriety, fitness.
5 A leaf.
6 The persons of a drama.
7 An order, a command.
8 The body.
9 A fit or competent person.
10 A measure of one Āḍhaka or of eight

Sers.
11

A receptacle of any kind, what holds or supports.
f. (-त्री)
A small or portable furnace.
E.
पा to preserve or retain, aff. त्रन्.

f. (-त्नी)
A wife.
E.
पति a husband, ङीप् aff., and नुक् augment.

m. (-टः)
The Haram, the private or women's apartments.
E.
पत्नी a wife, आट who goes, from अट, with घञ् affix, and आङ् prefix.

n. (-क)
1 A leaf.
2 The leaf of the Laurus cassia.
3 Staining the person with Sandal, &c. by way of decoration.
E.
पत्र with कन् added.

f. (-ला)
The noise made by the flapping of wings, or rustling of leaves.
E.
पत्र a leaf, a wing, &c. and काहल noise.

n. (-च्छ्रं)
A sort of penance, drinking infusion of any leaves for a given time.
E.
पत्र a leaf, and कृच्छ्र a penance.

m. (-प्तः)
A species of Euphorbia, commonly Teṅkānta Śij.
E.
पत्र a leaf, and गुप्त hidden.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Red sanders, (Pterocarpus santalinus); also पत्राङ्ग.

n. (-ङ्गं)
1 Red sanders, (Pterocarpus santolinus.)
2 Red or sappan wood, (Cæsalpinia sappan.)
3 Bhojpatra, a tree so called, a kind of

Birch.
4

Another plant: see पद्मक.
E.
पत्र a leaf, अङ्ग body or substance.

m. (-रः)
The current of a river: other authorities have in place of this word, पुरसंस्कार, and पत्रसंस्कार, which last appears to be most accurate.

f. (-णा)
Trimming the feathered butt of an arrow.
E.
पत the feather of an arrow, णी to get, aff. ड.

f. (-ला)
1 A woman.
2 A kind of barley.

m. (-रुः)
The foetid Mimosa.

m. (-कः)
A saw.
E.
पत्र a leaf, &c. and दॄ to tear, ण्वुल् aff.

f. (-का)
The fibre or vein of a leaf.
E.
पत्र a leaf, नाडी a vessel, aff. कन्.

m. (-शुः)
A small file used by silversmiths, &c.
E.
पत्र a sheet of metal, परशु an axe; also with पर्शु the same, पत्रपर्शु (-र्शुः.)

m. (-लः)
A large knife.
f. (-ली)
A pair of shears or scissors.
E.
पत्र a leaf, पाल to nourish, aff. अच्.

m. (-लः)
A large oar used as a rudder.
E.
पात्र a vessel, (a boat,) and पाल what cherishes.

f. (-श्या)
An ornament of the forehead, a piece of gold-leaf situate on the forehead, or a painted mark upon it.
E.
पत्र a leaf, पश to bind, aff. ण्यत्.

f. (-का)
A sort of cap or cover for the head, made of leaves.
E.
पत्र a leaf, पिशाचिका an imp.

m. (-ष्पः)
A plant, a red sort of Tulasī or Basil, (Ocymum pilosum.)
f. (-ष्पा)
Holy basil, (Ocymum sanctum.)
E.
पत्र a leaf, and पुष्प a flower.

m. (-कः)
A kind of birch, from the bark of which Hukka snakes, &c. are made: see भूर्ज्जपत्र.
E.
पत्र a leaf, and पुष्प a flower, कन् added.

m. (-न्धः)
Adorning with leaves, flowers, &c. decorating with nosegays or garlands.
E.
पत्र a leaf, and बन्ध a binding.

m. (-लः)
An oar, especially a large one used as a rudder.
E.
पत्र a leaf, बल to be strong, aff. घञ्.

mf. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी)
Decorating the person by staining it with fragrant pigments of sandal, musk, &c.
E.
पत्र a leaf, भञ्च to break, aff. अच्.

n. (-नं)
A new leaf, a sprout.
E.
पत्र a leaf, यौवन youth.

m. (-थः)
A bird.
E.
पच a wing, and रथ a vehicle.

n. (-नं)
Embellishing a page, illuminating, gilding, &c.
E.
पत्र, and रञ्जन colouring.

n. (-लं)
Thin or skim milk.
E.
पत to go, रल aff.

f. (-खा)
Decoration of the face or person, by means of fragrant pigments, consisting of Sandal, saffron, musk, &c.
E.
पत्र a leaf, and लेखा a line.

f. (-ल्ली)
Staining the person with Sandal, &c. by way of ornament.
E.
पत्र a leaf, and वल्ली a creeper; also पत्रावली, पचलेखा, &c.

f. (-लिः)
1 Red chalk.
2 A row of leaves.
3 Decorating the person.
E.
पत्र, and आवलि a line: see the next.

f. (-ली)
1 Drawing lines along the form; staining some parts of the body with coloured and fragrant pigments, as with saffron, Sandal, &c.
2 A mixture of young Aśvattha leaves with barley and honey.
E.
पत्र a leaf, and आवली a line: see पत्रलेखा, पत्रक, &c.

m. (-हः)
1 An arrow.
2 A bird.
3 A postman, a letter carrier.
E.
पत्र a feather, and बाह bearing.

f. (-रा)
The vein or fibre of a leaf.
E.
पत्र a leaf, and शिरा a tubular vessel.

m. (-ष्ठः)
The Bel tree.

m. (-रः)
The current of a river.
E.
पत्र a leaf, संस्कार making perfect: see पत्रझङ्कार.

m. (-रः)
1 The current of a river.
2 Cleaning a vessel that has been used.
E.
पात्र the channel, and संस्कार completion.

m. (-चिः)
A thorn.
E.
पत्र a leaf, and सूचि a needle.

n. (-मं)
Cold, wintry weather.
E.
पत्र here said to mean falling, हिम frost or snow.

m. (-स्यः)
The pungent leaf of the Laurus cassia.
E.
पत्र a leaf, and आख्या a name; the leaf, by way of distinction.

f. (-लिः)
Painting the forehead, throat, neck, &c. with coloured Sandal, saffron, or any other fragrant substance.
E.
पत्र a leaf, and अङ्गुलि a finger, being applied with the finger.

n. (-नं)
Ink or blacking.
E.
पत्र a leaf, (of a book,) and अञ्चन unction.

n. (-ढ्यं)
1 The root of long pepper.
2 A kind of grass.

f. (-ली)
Coloured ornamental marks on the face or person.
E.
पत्र, and आली a row.

f. (-का)
A leaf, a written leaf or page, a writing, a letter, &c.
E.
पत्र, and कन् added, fem. form.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Measured by a vessel, or the measure Pātra, sown with it, preparing it, &c.
2 Fit, adequate, appropriate.
E.
पात्र, and ष्ठन् aff.; also with घ aff. पात्रिय, and with यत्, पात्र्या, &c.

mfn. (-त्री-त्रिणी-त्रि)
1

Winged.
2

Feathered.
3

Having a page or leaf.
m. (-त्री)
1 An arrow.
2 A bird.
3 A falcon.
4 A tree.
5 A mountain.
6 A chariot.
7 A rider in a car or carriage.
f. (-णी)
A sprout, a shoot.
E.
पत्र a leaf, &c. इनि aff.

mfn. (-त्री-त्रिणी-त्रि)
1 Having a vessel.
2 Having fit or worthy persons.
E.
पात्र, and इनि aff.

m. (-गः)
A shower of arrows.
E.
पत्र, and पूग a heap.

m. (-रः)
A tree, (Cassia esculenta.)
E.
पत्र a leaf, उपस्कर a condiment.

n. (-र्णं)
Wove silk.
m. (-र्णः)
A plant, (Bignonia indica).
E.
पत्र a leaf, ऊर्णा wool.

m. (-सः)
A bud.
E.
पत्र, and उल्लास what delights.

m. (-लः)
A road.
E.
पत to go, सर Uṇādi aff., र changed to ल.

Falling.
2

Sin, wickedness.
E.
पत to fall, aff. क्विप्, and the radical vowel made long.

mfn. (पान् पान्ती पात्)
Who or what defends or preserves, a guardian, a protector, &c.
E.
पा to preserve, aff. शतृ.

m. (-गः)
Incurring guilt, acting sinfully.
E.
पातक, and योग accession.

m. (-ङ्गिः)
Saturn.
E.
पतङ्ग the sun, इञ् aff. of descent.

n. (-लं)
The Yoga system of philosophy.
E.
पतञ्जलि the sage by whom it was first taught, अण् aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 To be drunk.
2 To be preserved or protected.
E.
पा to drink, to preserve, तव्य aff.

n. (-लं)
The regions under the earth, and the abode of the Nāgas or serpents.
2 A hole, a chasm.
3 Submarine fire.
4 The fourth sign from that in which the sun is present.
m. (-लः)
A sort of apparatus for calcining and subliming metals, formed of two earthen pots, the upper one inverted over the lower, and the two joined together by their necks with cement, and placed in a hole containing fire.
E.
पत to alight, Uṇādi aff. आलञ्.

m. (-यः)
1 A demon, a

Daitya.
2

A Naga or infernal serpent.
E.
पाताल hell, and निलय abode.

m. (-काः)
An Asura, a demon.
E.
पाताल hell, ओकस a house.

m. (-कः)
The Gangetick porpoise.
E.
पात trembling, falling, ठक् aff.

mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति)
Going, going to, alighting, falling.
E.
पत to go, घिणुन् aff.

f. (-ली)
1 A trap or snare for catching deer.
2 A small earthen vessel or pot, especially used by religious mendicants.
3 A woman of a particular class.
E.
पात falling, इलच् aff, fem. aff. ङीप्.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Falling frequently or habitually, disposed to fall.
m. (-कः)
1 The declivity of a mountain, a precipice.
2 An aquatick animal of a large size; figuratively, the water elephant.
E.
पत to fall, aff. उकञ्.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Who or what protects or nourishes.
m. (-ता)
A plant, (Ocymum pilosum.)
E.
पा to nourish, तृच् aff.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
To be fallen, to be alighted.
E.
पत to fall, ण्यत् aff.

f. (-ता)
The quality or property of a preservative from sin.
E.
पात्त्र and तल् aff.; also with त्व, पात्त्रत्वं.

f. (-ता)
Capacity, fitness.
2 Appropriate state or circumstance.
3 The property or capacity of a cup or vessel.
4 Dignity, honor.
E.
पात्र capable, and तल् aff. of the abstract, quality; also with त्व aff., पात्रत्व.

mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
Spare, emaciate, thin.
m. (-टः)
Ragged garments.

m. (-रः)
1 An able or competent minister.
2 A vessel of metal, as silver, brass, &c.
3 Rust of iron.
4

Fire.
5

A heron.
6 A crow.
E.
पात्र a vessel, &c., and टीर aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
The object of a present or of respectful treatment.
E.
